database_schema_sql:
create schema if not exists cognitive;

create table if not exists cognitive.profile_groups (
  profile_id text primary key,
  label text not null,
  monitored boolean default true,
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

create table if not exists cognitive.state_conditions (
  state_id text primary key,
  label text not null,
  category text not null,
  risk_notes text,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

create table if not exists cognitive.state_profile_scores (
  score_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  state_id text references cognitive.state_conditions(state_id),
  profile_id text references cognitive.profile_groups(profile_id),
  rq_score numeric not null,
  zone text not null check (zone in ('DANGER','CAUTION','OPTIMAL','SUPERPOWER')),
  evidence_state text not null default 'PARTIAL' check (evidence_state in ('REAL','PARTIAL','PRETEND','BLOCKED')),
  source_ref text,
  created_at timestamptz default now(),
  unique(state_id, profile_id)
);

create table if not exists cognitive.surrender_metrics (
  metric_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id text,
  profile_id text references cognitive.profile_groups(profile_id),
  ai_answer_quality text check (ai_answer_quality in ('correct','incorrect','unknown')),
  accepted_ai_output boolean,
  override_used boolean,
  verification_step_used boolean,
  confidence_score numeric,
  error_detected boolean,
  cognitive_surrender_risk numeric,
  evidence_state text not null default 'PARTIAL' check (evidence_state in ('REAL','PARTIAL','PRETEND','BLOCKED')),
  source_ref text,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

create table if not exists cognitive.sovereignty_interventions (
  intervention_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_id text references cognitive.profile_groups(profile_id),
  trigger_condition text not null,
  intervention_type text not null check (intervention_type in ('micro_friction','verification_prompt','ai_fast','override_log','human_review','confidence_warning','evidence_request')),
  intervention_copy text not null,
  product_owner text,
  active boolean default true,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);
